Elevate Your Agency with AI-Driven Property Reports

You’re an estate agent—your reputation depends on swift, accurate insights and polished, client-ready reports. Meet our PropertyList AI Research Agent: designed to supercharge your listings, wow your clients and keep you leagues ahead of the competition.

Why Top Agents Can’t Do Without It

  • Win More Instructions
    Impress vendors with cutting-edge technology. Deliver hyper-detailed market analyses that demonstrate you know every square metre of their neighbourhood.

  • Delight Buyers
    Clients crave clear visuals and hard data. Hand them PDFs packed with instant price-per-sq m comparisons, commute maps, Ofsted ratings, and amenity-to-property distances.

  • Streamline Your Day
    No more wrestling with spreadsheets or Googling “planned developments.” Click once and receive every chart, stat and forecast in under 10 seconds.

Step-by-Step: From Click to Close

  1. Spot the “AI Analysis” Button
    On any PropertyList.es MLS entry, you’ll find the bright “AI Analysis” button alongside your listing.

  2. Refine the Scope
    In the pop-up, add precise details—street name (“Oxford Street”), landmark (“opposite Selfridges”), or local insights (“so close to Hyde Park”). The more exact you are, the sharper the AI’s output.

  3. Let AI Do the Heavy Lifting
    Hit “Analyse.” Immediately you’ll see:

    • Comparative Market Report: Your property versus the top 12 comparable – price trends, average days on market, value-drivers

    • Local Deep-Dive: School performance, crime figures, green-space proximities, and even café-to-tube station distances

    • Future Developments: Planned builds, zoning changes, new Crossrail or Cycle Superhighway links—keep well ahead of market shifts

  4. Customise & Share
    Choose your report style – Vendor Proposal, Buyer Guide, Investor Brief or Tenant Pack -and download as:

    • Mobile-optimised PDF for viewings on the move

    • Printable layout PDF for open-house or more personal handouts

Agent Pro Tips

  • Tweak Before Sending: Give the AI’s copy a quick once-over—add your agency’s tone or branding touches.
  • Flip the Focus: Switch between “Vendor Report” (emphasising ROI and price-per-sq m) and “Buyer Report” (highlighting lifestyle and amenities).

Stay Ahead. Impress Clients. Close Quicker.
Log in to PropertyList.es, click “AI Analysis” on any listing, and let our AI Property Research Agent give your agency the unrivalled edge – one report at a time.

Sharing properties is FREE but that’s not all PropertyList.es is. 
PropertyList uses a credit system to unlock various extra features like featuring your listings, CRM and options designed to maximise your listing’s exposure and generate leads.

Purchasing Credits:

  • Top Up Your Account: You can easily purchase credits directly through the “Credits” tab or by clicking any extra features within your account.
  • Follow the prompts to purchase credits. You’ll need to provide payment information. PropertyList.es is secured by Cloudflare, review PropertyList Site Safety & Security here.
  • Once the transaction is complete, your new credits will be added to your account.
  • Credits do not expire.

How it works?

Buy credits (1 Credit = €1)  ➡  Use them when you want for extra features

No monthly fees.

Pay for what you want, when you want.

What Credits do for you?

Credits empower you to leverage a variety of features across three main categories: MLS, CRM and Property Portal.

1. Enhance Your MLS Presence:

This ensures maximum visibility to a vast network of agents actively searching for new listings. Featured properties receive significantly more views than regular listings, ensuring your property remains top of mind for fellow agents.

2. Supercharge Your Public Portal Listings: COMING SOON

  • Feature on Public Property Portal (coming Soon): Showcase your property prominently by featuring it within the Public Property Portal, attracting local and global buyers and renters.

By leveraging their extensive reach, you can tap into a vast pool of motivated individuals ready to make a move, both locally and internationally. With prominent placement and targeted tools, you can generate a pipeline of direct leads eager to explore your listing.
  • and much more coming soon!

In essence, credits allow you to unlock powerful tools to customise your PropertyList.es experience.

See All Features & Pricing

For additional advantages, explore our paid features: expand your reach with MLS exposure and attract targeted leads through the Property Portal. With credits, you can maximise your listing’s potential and connect directly with qualified leads actively seeking properties like yours.

What is included in this manual?

We hope you find this manual helpful. If you have any questions, please contact PropertyList support.

Desktop App:

  1. Open your chrome web browser and login to https://agents.propertylist.es.
  2. Click the 3 dots in the top right corner.
  3. Look for “Cast, save and share and click it.
  4. Select “Install page as app…”

  6. Pin the app to you taskbar. Select “Yes”

Android App:

  1. Open your chrome web browser  and login to https://agents.propertylist.es.
  2. Tap the 3 dots menu at the top right corner.
  3. Select “Add to Home screen.” and Click “Install”.
  4. Name the shortcut (e.g., “PropertyList”) and tap “Add.”
  5. Confirm the addition by tapping “Add” again, and the shortcut or app will appear on your home screen.

iPhone (iOS) Shortcut:

  1. Open Safari and login to https://agents.propertylist.es.
  2. Tap the Share icon (the square with an arrow pointing up).
  3. Scroll down and select “Add to Home Screen.”
  4. Name the shortcut (e.g., “PropertyList “) and tap “Add.”

Listing your property on PropertyList MLS is a breeze, and you can do it from anywhere – even your mobile! Our tech team is constantly innovating to make the platform even smoother and more effective.

While PropertyList MLS offers the convenience of uploading your properties via an XML feed, we recommend adding them directly to the system for maximum control. This method gives you more flexibility to tailor each listing’s details and ensure accuracy.

Two Upload Options:

  • XML Feed: Upload your existing properties quickly and efficiently with an XML feed. This is a great time-saver if you have a large number of listings to add but be aware, it will overwrite any properties you’ve already added directly to the system.
    For this reason, we recommend using the XML feed first to get your initial properties uploaded. Then, as you acquire new listings, you can simply add them directly to PropertyList MLS for maximum control. – XML Export Feeds Provided.
  • Manual upload (Recommended): Take full control of your listings by adding them directly to PropertyList MLS. This method allows you to carefully craft descriptions, select the most relevant features, and ensure all information is accurate before publishing. 

Whichever method you choose, be sure to review our guide on the differences between the two in the sections below before uploading.

Maximise Visibility with Detailed Listings:

Regardless of the upload method, providing comprehensive details and selecting all applicable features is crucial! Property hunters often filter searches based on specific features. For example, if your listing boasts an indoor pool, selecting that feature guarantees it gets shown to those seeking exactly that amenity.

List Your Property Now!

COMING SOON: Unlock High-Quality Leads with PropertyList

Struggling to find qualified leads for your listings? PropertyList has the solution with Public Portal Leads. Connect with serious buyers and renters actively searching for properties.

What are Portal Leads?

At PropertyList, we generate valuable leads from buyers and tenants browsing our portal. Our extensive advertising efforts ensure your properties receive maximum exposure, delivering the best direct leads possible.

The Pay-Per-Enquiry Advantage

With our pay-per-enquiry model, when a lead comes in, you will see the request without contact information. If you decide to purchase the lead using your credits, the contact information will be revealed. This ensures you only connect with motivated individuals, eliminating wasted costs.

Meticulously Screened Leads

We ensure the leads you receive are relevant and qualified, saving you time on filtering through irrelevant enquiries and allowing you to focus on serious prospects. Additionally, if you receive an “agent” lead, your credits will be promptly returned.

How to Leverage Portal Leads

  • Optimise Your Listings: Craft compelling headlines, detailed descriptions, and high-quality photos. Use smart keywords to help property seekers find what they’re looking for.

  • Respond Promptly: Quickly respond to enquiries to keep leads engaged. We recommend responding within 48 hours. If the lead is rejected or not opened within 72h, it will be redirected to a duplicate property for the best user experience.

  • Professional Communication: Be prompt, courteous, and informative in your responses to foster trust.

Easy Management of Portal Leads

All leads are delivered to the dedicated “PORTAL LEADS” tab in your account. You can:

  • Easily Access and Review Leads: View all incoming leads in one location.
  • Effortless Lead Assignment: Assign leads to team members for efficient follow-up.
  • Automated Contact Creation: Each lead is converted into a contact, linked with their enquiry for easy management.

Pipeline Tracking: Your Roadmap to Real Estate Success on PropertyList.es

Ever feel like you’re juggling leads without a clear picture of where each one stands in the process? Pipeline tracking on PropertyList.es offers a powerful solution, giving you a real-time view of your sales funnel through a visual chart and empowering you to close more deals.

What is Pipeline Tracking?

Imagine a roadmap for your potential clients – that’s what pipeline tracking does. It allows you to visualise the stages each lead progresses through, from initial contact to successful completion. 

Benefits for Agents:

  • Identify Bottlenecks: Easily see if leads are getting stuck at a particular stage, like “Viewed” but not moving to “Reserved”. This helps you identify areas where your process needs improvement. Perhaps follow-up communication after viewings could be enhanced.
  • Prioritise Leads: Focus your efforts on leads with the highest closing potential. Allocate time and resources accordingly.
  • Improved Communication: Stay informed about each lead’s progress and ensure timely follow-up at each stage. 
  • Accurate Forecasting: Gain insights into your projected sales based on the composition of your pipeline. 

Benefits for Administrators:

  • Team Overview: Monitor the overall health of the company’s sales pipeline. See how different agents are performing and identify areas for potential coaching or resource allocation.
  • Filter & Analyse: Drill down into specific team members, property types (apartments, houses, etc.), or stages of the pipeline to gain deeper insights. For instance, analyse which property types convert most frequently from “Viewed” to “Reserved”.
  • Data-Driven Decisions: Use pipeline data to make strategic decisions regarding marketing efforts, resource allocation, and overall sales strategy.
  • Advanced Team Management: Assign staff members to specific leads or contacts within the pipeline. This allows for efficient task delegation and ensures leads are nurtured by the most relevant team member based on their expertise or location.

PropertyList.es takes pipeline tracking a step further:

  • Lead Scoring (Coming Soon): The platform incorporates lead scoring to prioritise leads based on their likelihood of converting. Leads who demonstrate strong interest through detailed enquiries or multiple viewing requests might be assigned a higher score.
  • Customisable Stages (Coming Soon): Adapt the sales stages to your specific process for a more tailored experience. You might want to add a stage for following up after an offer is submitted.
  • Reporting & Insights (Coming Soon): Generate reports that provide valuable data and insights into your sales performance. Track trends over time, compare agent performance, and identify areas for improvement.

Stop juggling leads and take control of your sales pipeline today! Sign up for free on PropertyList.es and experience the power of a visual sales roadmap. Close more deals, gain valuable insights, and streamline your real estate business.

Sign up today!

/docs/propertylist-mls-user-manual/micro.body:
PropertyList.es offers different ways to share your property with direct leads/contacts.

No Website? No Problem!

PropertyList.es offers each agent a FREE, whitelabel, uniquely branded website link, known as a "MicroSite," to share all or selected properties:
https://Your-Agency-Name.estate-agency.co
(estate-agency.co is not conected to any other domain)

This dedicated MicroSite allows you to:

  • Effortlessly showcase MLS properties: Create a stunning online presence for your agency and show as a full website or highlight your selected properties with your own branding for your clients.
  • Simplify lead capture: A built-in contact form captures leads directly from potential buyers and renters which links automatically to contacts in your account.

Smart Lead Management

Stay updated with platform notifications and email alerts.

  • New Leads: When someone enquires about a specific property, a new contact is automatically created in your account. The message and the enquired property are linked in the timeline.
  • Existing Contacts: When someone already in your database enquires, their contact timeline is updated with the message, and the enquired property is linked to their profile.

This eliminates manual data entry and ensures you stay organised while following up with every lead.

  • Every link generated is unique and links back to the user who created it, allowing admin and staff to easily track what they have sent and monitor the leads generated from their links. WIth admin access you can oversee this in the "MicroSite Leads" Tab.

MicroSite Options:

  • Check the box: Link your selected shared properties to a branded mini-website via your logo in the header.

  • Uncheck the box: The logo in the header will either link to your agency's website (if added) or be disabled.

How to share properties:

a.  Select a Property: Choose the specific property you want to share.

b.  Click "SHARE": This will generate a unique link for that property.

c.  Share Instantly & Save to Contact: Easily share the link via WhatsApp, social media, email, or any other platform. 
Here you can save a note that the link was shared with a specific or new contact in your account.

Every MicroSite Link comes with a built-in contact form. When someone clicks on your property and fills out the form, you'll receive a "MICROSITE LEAD" in your account.

If the contact is already saved in your account, their contact history will be updated to reflect when and what you sent, and you'll receive an email notification.

If the contact is not saved in your account, the system will automatically create a new contact with the relevant information and message in the timeline, and you will be notified.

Streamline your communication and connect with potential clients effortlessly."

PropertyList.es MLS & CRM: Frequently Asked Questions

  • General
  • Listings & Properties
  • Agents & Users
  • Additional Resources

Does Propertylist.es require a credit card to join?

No, a form of payment is NOT required to join. Only if you want to buy credits.

Is PropertyList.es free to use?

Yes, PropertyList.es is FREE to use with paid features within the system that are optional.

What are the benefits of using PropertyList.es?

For Freelancers: 
PropertyList.es allows freelancers to share their listings at no cost. This cost-efficient approach is especially helpful for those starting out in the industry.

For Agencies: 
Agencies can freely share their properties with a wide audience. Additionally, they can manage staff accounts, listings, events, and documents—all in one place.

For Developers: 
Listing new developments for free on PropertyList.es helps developers reach thousands of agents and buyers. It also facilitates connections with property services that may prove valuable.

For Property Services: 
We welcome all services related to property, connect with estate agents, developers, and property seekers, expanding your network and business opportunities.

For Buyers/Renters:
1. Extensive Property Listings: PropertyList.es aggregates a wide range of properties, making it easier for buyers and renters to find their ideal home or investment.
2. Agent Expertise: Buyers and renters can benefit from the expertise of real estate agents associated with the platform. Agents can guide them through the process, answer questions, and provide insights.
3. Advanced Search Filters: Users can filter properties based on specific criteria (such as location, price range, amenities, etc.), saving time and effort.

What is an MLS & CRM?

Multiple Listing Service (MLS): This is a platform specifically designed for real estate agents to share information and collaborate on listings. PropertyList.es facilitates this agent-to-agent communication, allowing agents to expose their listings to a wider pool of potential buyers and renters represented by other agents on the platform totally FREE!

Customer Relationship Management (CRM): This is a FREE software system that helps agents manage their interactions with clients. PropertyList.es’ CRM features help agents track leads, manage communications, and stay organised throughout the sales or rental process.

What is PropertyList.es?

PropertyList.es is a full-service solution for real estate agents in Spain. It functions as both a Multiple Listing Service (MLS) and a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platform.

How can I access property market data on PropertyList.es?

Coming Soon – PropertyList.es provides access to valuable market data, including trends, comparative analysis tools, and insights into buyer preferences.

Can I link/add properties to a contact’s profile?

Yes, PropertyList.es allows you to link properties to contacts. Learn how to do this here.

How do I list a property on PropertyList.es?

You’ll need to be a registered agent with a PropertyList.es account. The specific listing process can be found here.

How can I assign a contact to a specific agent?

PropertyList.es allows you to assign contacts to agents for streamlined communication and task management. Learn how to assign your contact a staff member here.

Can I add professional contacts to a client’s profile?

Yes, PropertyList.es allows you to link professional contacts (lawyers, architects, etc.) to your client’s profile. You can specify the type of professional relationship for better organization. Learn more here.

How do I sign up for PropertyList.es?

Sign up for FREE here. (NO credit card information required, ever!)

Does PropertyList.es offer customer support?

PropertyList.es offers customer support here and a Forum for members, find your question or ask it here.

Not signed up yet? Get a FREE account and connect with agents throughout Andalucía. Streamline collaboration and close more deals.
